# QuickJS regular expression engine

Upstream: https://github.com/bellard/quickjs

Revision: `04be246001599f5995fa2f2d8c91a0f198d3f34c`

The listed source files are vendored unchanged under the accompanying MIT license.
CPrime uses the standalone regular expression engine, Unicode tables, and C utilities.
Runtime allocation/stack callbacks and the C++ adapter are owned in `src/runtime/` and `include/runtime/`.
